Seconds if the cook likes you. Prices subject to change. Printed by the ship's system. Form G-98, sheet 2 of 2. 1998. Crew notes: Chris Rock's Lee Butters joins the crew. Wah Sing Ku, played by Jet Li, a very fast fighter. Murtaugh hiding a family of immigrants on his boat.

Murtaugh's Boat GalleyLethal Weapon 4The family gets bigger.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersChinatown dumplingsPork, prawn and shiitake dumplings with ginger and soyHow to make it300g pork mince150g raw prawns, peeled and chopped3 shiitake mushrooms1 tbsp grated ginger1 tbsp soy sauce24 wonton wrappers1 small carrotChop the prawns and mushrooms. Mix with the pork, ginger and soy.Spoon into the wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides leaving the top open and add a dot of grated carrot.Steam in batches until cooked through.Leo's wonton crispsFried wonton triangles tossed in salt and five spice, sweet chilli dipHow to make it20 wonton wrappers1 L vegetable oil, for frying1/2 tsp fine salt1 pinch Chinese five spice120ml sweet chilli sauceCut the wrappers into triangles.Fry in 180°C oil in batches until puffed and golden.Drain and toss with salt and five spice. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.MainsUncle Benny's roast duckDuck dried overnight, rubbed with five spice and salt, then roasted and glazedHow to make it2kg whole duck2 tsp Chinese five spice1 tbsp salt2 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce20 mandarin pancakes1 cucumber4 spring onions100ml hoisin sauceThe night before, prick the duck all over and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry.Rub inside the cavity with five spice and salt.Roast at 180°C.Glaze with honey and soy and roast for the last stretch.Rest the duck, then carve.Slice the cucumber and spring onions. Serve with pancakes and hoisin.Murtaugh's whole barbecued snapperA fishing boat should mean fish for dinnerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole snapper scored and stuffed with lemon, garlic and herbs, grilled over hot coals until the skin blisters, with charred lemon and garlic butter.Score 2 whole snapper (about 800g each) three times on each side, rub with oil and salt, and stuff with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, parsley and dill.Grill over medium-hot coals or a barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes a side until the flesh flakes at the bone.Grill 2 halved lemons cut side down.Melt 60g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley and spoon over the fish.SweetsFortune cookiesCrisp vanilla cookies folded into the classic shapeHow to make it3 egg whites100g caster sugar60g plain flour40g butter, melted1/2 tsp vanilla extract12 paper fortunesWhisk the egg whites with the sugar, then stir in the flour, butter and vanilla.Write the fortunes on strips of paper.Spread the batter into thin circles on a lined tray.Bake at 180°C in batches.Working fast, fold each warm cookie around a fortune.DrinksUncle Benny's lychee ginger highballGin, lychee syrup and lime topped with ginger ale, lychee garnishHow to make it1 tin lychees (565g)180ml gin1 tray ice1 lime600ml ginger ale, cold1 knob fresh gingerDrain the lychees, keeping the syrup.Fill glasses with ice, add the gin, some lychee syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.Top with ginger ale and stir once.Thread a lychee onto a cocktail pick with a thin slice of ginger and lay it across each glass.
